author: mcleonage
quote:
I wrote a long thesis here and it wouldn't let me post due to ads.

Tldr

Fake simulation of life, it makes fun of hardships, women, men, and the hard life, its a facade of what coming up through a tough time feels like.

Its not gta its not rdr its a new genre of sloppy writing. 

Relationship feels empty and forced, would be much better if it wasn't the only plot piece that forces endings as I did two endings with a pre save and read the rest.

I wish you could have chosen a character to play as, the other being a npc that is your heist partner and found an actual relationship through npcs in the game not forced fake love and journey.

The new police system I do enjoy, the random crap to do is annoying but also immersion that I like overall. 

The fact that you are professional without spilling blood is stupid if someone puts a gun to your head and you kill them it shouldn't make you a bad person.

Its writing just feels like a tiktok reel and trendy cute quotes and not at all how a real world relationship feels like, and im married happily awaiting a child.

I think its disgusting you put a "your bad parents" as the characters to play. I find it sick that you say its a free to have your own life experience when its not, that freedom is just random npc spawn events.


I HATE how long its dragged out for little actual impact, just like ubisoft games...

You dont need to go on a killing rampage, you do not need to shoot up clubs. You do not need hookers.

You need a real life experience like promised but instead you forced us to live a weird hollow life of two people supposedly inlove but it feels like a forced marriage and a Saturday romcom. 

Disappointed heavily...
